T: The richest kid in the world wants a mate and a burger.
D: The world's richest boy has everything except friends, until villains try to steal the family fortune.
P: Serve the mains when Richie takes his new friends to his own burger bar at the mansion.
S: Parmesan and thyme crisps spooned into coin shapes, baked at 190C for 6 minutes until golden, served with fig jam and soft cheese.
Small blinis topped with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, laid out on silver trays.
the inventor's workshop under the mansion

Bite-sized chicken thigh soaked in buttermilk, fried in a crunchy cornflake crust, tossed in a parmesan and garlic dust with a honey sriracha dip. Cut 600g chicken thighs into 2cm pieces and soak in 250ml buttermilk with salt for 1 hour. Crush 100g cornflakes and mix with 50g plain flour and 1 tsp garlic powder. Toss the chicken in the crumbs and fry at 175C for 4 minutes until golden. Toss hot with 30g finely grated parmesan and a pinch of salt. Mix 3 tbsp honey with 1 tsp sriracha and 2 tbsp mayonnaise to dip.
M: the burger counter built right into his house
Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles, onion and special sauce on soft sesame buns, with fries and a thick shake.
dinner in the huge dining room

Seared beef fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles, prosciutto and golden puff pastry, with a glossy beef and thyme jus and buttery mash. Sear 4 x 150g beef fillet steaks hard for 1 minute a side and cool. Fry 300g finely chopped mushrooms with garlic and thyme until dry. Lay 2 slices prosciutto on each, spread with mushroom, add a steak and wrap. Wrap each in a square of puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 220C for 18 minutes. Reduce 400ml beef stock with thyme to a jus. Serve with mash.
W: the family vault at Mount Richmore
Vanilla ice cream with salted caramel sauce, crushed honeycomb and a chocolate coin on top in a tall glass.

Vanilla ice cream blended with milk and malt powder until thick, poured into tall glasses with a straw.

s.how: Mix 150g grated parmesan with chopped thyme. Spoon small rounds onto a lined tray and flatten into coins. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until golden and lacy, then cool on the tray. Serve stacked like coins with fig jam and a wedge of brie.

Warm 16 blinis in a low oven for 5 minutes. Top each with a small spoon of creme fraiche, a little salmon roe and a few snipped chives. Add a tiny squeeze of lemon and lay them out in neat rows on silver trays like a proper mansion party.

m.note: the burger counter built right into his house
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into 4 balls and smash flat on a very hot pan. Season, flip after 2 minutes and add American cheese. Mix mayonnaise with chopped pickles for special sauce. Build on toasted buns with onion and pickles and serve with oven fries.

w.note: the family vault at Mount Richmore
w.how: Melt 150g sugar to amber, then whisk in 150ml cream and a pinch of salt for caramel sauce. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, pour over the caramel and scatter with crushed honeycomb. Top each sundae with a gold chocolate coin.

d.note: playing baseball with real kids at last
d.how: Blend 4 big scoops of vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick and smooth. Pour into tall chilled glasses, add a straw to each and serve straight away while still frothy on top.
